title: Sun in your birth chart: identity, authority and the father | Ask Tota
description: Surya rules one sign, burns everything near it, and is classed as a malefic. Here is what the Sun actually runs in a chart, house by house, and why it is not your personality.
og_title: The Sun in ur chart is not ur personality
og_description: Surya rules one sign, is the only graha that burns others, and is technically a malefic. Here is what it actually runs.
h1: the sun in ur chart is not ur personality
dek: surya rules a single sign, burns anything that comes near it, and is formally classed as a malefic. here is what the sun genuinely carries in a vedic chart, why the sign u call ur star sign is the least of it, and what it does in each of the twelve houses.

faq.q: what does the sun represent in vedic astrology?
faq.a: the soul, the self, vitality, authority, the father, government and anything official. surya is called atmakaraka in the general sense, the significator of the atma. it is what u are built around rather than how u behave.

faq.q: which sign does the sun rule?
faq.a: simha, and only simha. the sun and the moon are the only grahas that rule a single sign each. its mooltrikona is simha from 0 to 20 degrees.

faq.q: where is the sun exalted and debilitated?
faq.a: exalted in mesha, deepest at 10 degrees, and debilitated in tula, deepest at 10 degrees. mesha is mars's sign of direct action and tula is venus's sign of weighing other people.

faq.q: is the sun a benefic or a malefic?
faq.a: a natural malefic, which surprises most people. the classical term is krura, meaning harsh rather than evil. the sun burns what it touches, and that is a description of intensity, not of morality.

faq.q: what is combustion and why is the sun involved?
faq.a: a graha too close to the sun loses its independent voice and is called astangata, burnt. the sun is the only graha that causes this and the only one that can never suffer it.

faq.q: which nakshatras does the sun rule?
faq.a: krittika, uttara phalguni and uttara ashadha. if ur moon was in one of those at birth, ur vimshottari dasha sequence started with the sun.

faq.q: which house is the sun strongest in?
faq.a: the 10th, by directional strength. digbala is the strength a graha gains from a particular direction, and the sun gets its full share in the 10th house of career and public standing.

faq.q: does the sun sign matter in vedic astrology?
faq.a: less than u have been told. it is one position out of nine, and indian practice weights the moon and the lagna far more heavily. it is also computed sidereally, so it is often not the sign u grew up calling urs.

faq.q: what does the sun say about my father?
faq.a: the tradition treats surya as the significator of the father, alongside the 9th house. read them together rather than separately, and read the condition of the graha rather than jumping to a conclusion about a real person.

faq.q: is a debilitated sun in tula bad?
faq.a: it is the placement where the self is least comfortable asserting itself alone, in the sign that weighs everybody else's view. it is common, cancellations apply, and plenty of very effective people have it.

faq.q: what is the difference between the sun and the lagna?
faq.a: the sun is what u are built around. the lagna is how u arrive and the frame every house is counted from. they answer different questions and the lagna is the more structural of the two.
